'''''Letter from Christophsis''''' was a letter from then&ndash;[[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] addressed to her friend [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. Because of its subject matter, it was notable as being a rare firsthand account of one of the important battles during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The letter eventually ended up among the papers of the [[Yularen family]].

==Behind the scenes==
The letter was first appeared in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].
